title: Facts: assert, retract, observe
preamble:
# Facts: assert, retract, observe

How an integrator gets data into and out of libds's working memory: declaring
schemas, asserting facts, reading them back, observing what the engine emits,
and retracting. Companion to [NLFC] (engine
create / free / pump) and [NCBK] (the action-verb side).

## What this is not

- Not the language spec for facts. Author-side semantics live in
  [LFAC] — `logical` vs `ttl` lifecycles, no-op reassertion discipline, mixing
  categories in one rule.
- Not the schema-design guide. Designing schema shapes is a language-level
  concern; this doc covers the **registration mechanics** the integrator drives.
